title: The Swellies — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 102bpm walking bass brushed drums character portrait unhurried Spanish French language learning Pete ocean Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Out past Rottnest Island where the swells come up from the south
Pete knows where the current turns and where to keep your mouth
About the conditions — some days you don't say a word
You just watch the water and you let the water be heard

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Más allá de Rottnest Island donde las olas vienen del sur
[Out past Rottnest Island where the swells come from the south]
Pete sabe dónde gira la corriente y la ley del mar puro
[Pete knows where the current turns and the law of the pure sea]
Algunos días no dices nada — solo observas
[Some days you say nothing — you just watch]
El agua habla por sí sola y Pete escucha las curvas
[The water speaks for itself and Pete listens to the curves]

[Chorus — English]
The swells come up from Antarctica without an explanation
They cross the Indian Ocean with considerable dedication
The swellies off the coast of Perth have run for two thousand miles
Before they meet a Pelican charter and Pete's nautical miles
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Au-delà de Rottnest Island où les vagues viennent du sud
[Out past Rottnest Island where the swells come from the south]
Pete connaît chaque courant et chaque vague brut
[Pete knows every current and every raw wave]
Certains jours on ne dit rien — on écoute l'eau
[Some days you say nothing — you listen to the water]
L'océan Indien parle et Pete connaît les mots
[The Indian Ocean speaks and Pete knows the words]

[Outro — All three languages]
The swellies know Pete… Las olas conocen a Pete… Les vagues connaissent Pete
From Antarctica to Perth — De la Antártida a Perth — De l'Antarctique à Perth
That's my boy
